articles.summary: John Marshall Bancorp, Inc. (Nasdaq: JMSB) (“John Marshall”), the parent company of John Marshall Bank, and Eagle Financial Services, Inc. (Nasdaq: EFSI) (“EFSI”), the parent company of Bank of Clarke, today jointly announced that the Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond approved the application to merge Bank of Clarke with and into John Marshall Bank. The Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond also waived any application under the Bank Holding Company Act with respect to the eventual merger of EFSI with and into John Marshall. The transaction remains subject to the approvals of the Virginia Bureau of Financial Institutions and the shareholders of John Marshall and EFSI, along with the satisfaction of other customary closing conditions. The special meetings for John Marshall and EFSI are scheduled to be held on November 19, 2026. John Marshall and EFSI announced the signing of a definitive merger agreement on September 8, 2026. articles.title: John Marshall Bancorp, Inc. and Eagle Financial Services, Inc. Announce Receipt of Federal Reserve Approval to Complete Merger
